title: Valid Palindrome II
statement: Return true when `s` is a palindrome, or becomes a palindrome after deleting at most one character.
hints: Two pointers find the first mismatch.
At the mismatch you may skip the left character or the right character, but not both in different places.
Check whether either remaining slice is a strict palindrome.
editorial: Walk inward. While the characters match, continue. On a mismatch, the answer is true when s[left+1:right+1] is a palindrome or s[left:right] is a palindrome. A second mismatch inside either check fails that branch. You do not get a second deletion.
